new.name: A.P. Beaver Nymph
new.description: One of Andre Puyans' A.P. nymphs: a moose hair tail, wing case and legs over a dubbed beaver body with a fine gold rib.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it dead-drift as a general mayfly nymph.
steps: Tie in a few moose hairs as a short tail and the gold wire.
Dub a tapered beaver abdomen and rib it.
Tie in a bunch of moose hair for the wing case and dub the thorax.
Pull the moose hair over, split the tips back as legs and dub a small head.

new.name: Armadillo
new.description: A big bass bug with a black marabou tail, rubber legs, a peacock blue schlappen collar, an Ice Dub body and stacked foam discs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly on the surface; it gurgles and the legs keep moving.
mats: Black and white round rubber legs
steps: Tie in a marabou tail with rubber legs at the bend.
Wind a schlappen collar and dub a short Ice Dub section.
Slide foam discs onto the shank and glue them in place.
Add more legs between the discs and finish at the eye.

new.name: Ice Pick
new.description: An articulated streamer with a marabou tail, palmered Baitfish Emulator, an Ice Wing fibre body under barred zonker and a Fish Skull head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause for big trout and bass.
mats: Ice Wing fibre with barred zonker over the top
steps: Tie a marabou tail and palmer Baitfish Emulator on the rear hook.
Join it to the front hook with beading wire.
Tie Ice Wing fibre along the front hook with a barred zonker strip on top.
Fit the Fish Skull head and finish.

new.name: Ball Peen Craw
new.description: A smallmouth crayfish with copper flash, a pumpkin sili leg tail, an SLF and craw dub body and stacked bead chain eyes for weight.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it along rocky bottoms.
mats: Pumpkin and black flake sili legs
Whitlock SLF crayfish brown and rusty brown craw dub
Large black bead chain, four sets
steps: Tie the bead chain eyes in a row behind the hook eye for weight.
Tie in copper flash and a sili leg tail at the bend.
Dub a buggy craw body forward.
Figure-eight dubbing through the eyes and pick it out.

new.name: Big Fish
new.description: Phil Rowley's stillwater nymph with a deer hair tail and underbody, a gold rib, a scud dub body, a pheasant wing case and pheasant legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near the bottom in lakes.
steps: Tie in a deer hair tail and lash the butts along the shank as an underbody.
Tie in the rib and dub the abdomen, then rib it.
Tie in pheasant tail for the wing case and dub the thorax.
Pull the wing case over and split the tips back as legs.

new.name: Bergman Black Ant
new.description: The Black Ant from Ray Bergman's Trout, with a lacquered thread body in two humps and a black hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a wet or damp ant near banks.
steps: Build a rear hump of thread and coat it with lacquer.
Build a smaller front hump and lacquer it.
Tie in a black hackle between the humps.
Wind two turns and finish.

new.name: Black Midge
new.description: A simple black wet fly with a floss body, a floss rib and a black hen hackle, for off-colour spring streams.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in early spring when midges hatch in coloured water.
steps: Wrap a slim floss body.
Rib it with a twisted strand of floss.
Tie in a black hen hackle.
Wind two turns and finish.

new.name: Rosborough Black Midge Pupa
new.description: Polly Rosborough's midge pupa with an ostrich flue tag, a grizzly hackle tag and a muskrat body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near the surface in lakes.
steps: Tie in a short black ostrich flue at the bend.
Add a turn of grizzly hackle over it.
Dub a muskrat body forward.
Build a small head and finish.

new.name: Blended Thread Chironomid
new.description: Phil Rowley's chironomid with a body of blended thread colours, a red butt, an anti-static bag rib, a rust thorax and a black bead.
new.fishing_tips: Hang it under an indicator just off the bottom.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the rib.
Wrap a short red butt.
Build a slim tapered body blending thread colours and rib it.
Wrap a rust thread thorax behind the bead.

new.name: Blue Devil
new.description: A Carrie Stevens streamer with a silver tag, a red or black floss body, a silver rib, a white bucktail underbelly and a blue feather wing.
new.fishing_tips: Troll or strip it for landlocked salmon and brook trout.
steps: Tie a silver tag and wind a floss body.
Rib it with silver tinsel.
Tie in a white bucktail underbelly.
Set the wing hackles on top and build a banded head.

new.name: Blue Quill Wet
new.description: A wet Blue Quill with a dun tail, a stripped bleached peacock quill body, a dun hackle and goose quill wings.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it during early season blue quill hatches.
steps: Tie in a dun tail.
Wrap a stripped quill body.
Tie in a dun hackle as a beard.
Tie a pair of goose quill slips on top.

new.name: Bluegill Bee
new.description: A panfish fly with a gold bead, a red flash tail, a banded black and yellow chenille body and a yellow schlappen hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly for bluegill.
steps: Slide on the bead and add lead.
Tie in a red flash tail.
Wrap alternating black and yellow chenille bands.
Wind a yellow schlappen collar.

new.name: Bradley Special
new.description: A British wet fly with a red tail, a red squirrel body twisted with red silk, a mallard wing and a red hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets.
mats: Red squirrel back twisted with two strands of red silk
steps: Tie in a red tail.
Twist red squirrel into the silk and wrap the body.
Tie in a red hackle as a beard.
Tie a mallard flank wing and finish.

new.name: Brown Hen
new.description: A simple Bergman wet fly with a silver tip, a black chenille body, a brown turkey wing and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for brook trout.
steps: Tie a silver tip.
Wrap a black chenille body.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Tie a brown turkey wing on top.

new.name: Buckskin
new.description: A tiny nymph with a stiff brown tail and a chamois body, an old western tailwater fly.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep below a heavier nymph.
steps: Tie in a short brown tail.
Tie in a thin strip of chamois.
Wrap it forward in overlapping turns.
Build a thread head and finish.

new.name: Carrie's Fancy
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver tag and rib, a red floss body, a blue schlappen hackle, a peacock underwing and four hackle wings.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocked salmon.
steps: Tie the silver tag and wind a red floss body.
Rib it with silver tinsel.
Add a blue schlappen throat and a peacock underwing.
Set four hackles as the wing and finish a banded head.

new.name: Carrie's Special
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver body, a white bucktail underbelly, a white hackle and crest throat and a golden feather wing.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks.
mats: White hackle and golden pheasant crest
steps: Wind a silver body.
Tie in a white bucktail underbelly.
Add the white hackle and crest throat.
Set the wing and build a banded head.

new.name: Clown Shoe Caddis
new.description: A caddis with a clear D-Rib body, an elk wing, a cerise foam post, a black thorax and a grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in caddis hatches where you need to see the fly.
steps: Wrap a clear D-Rib body around the bend.
Tie in an elk wing.
Tie in a cerise foam post and dub the thorax.
Wind the grizzly hackle around the post.

new.name: Colonel Bates
new.description: A classic Rangeley streamer with a red tail, a silver body, a brown hackle, yellow and white hackle wings and mallard shoulders.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocked salmon and brook trout.
mats: Two yellow and two white rooster cape hackles
steps: Tie a silver tag and a red tail.
Wind a silver body.
Add a brown schlappen throat.
Set the wing hackles with mallard shoulders and finish.

new.name: Conover
new.description: An old Catskill dry with a straw tail, a claret mix of red wool and muskrat body and a golden badger hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a general dry on Catskill-style streams.
mats: Red wool and muskrat mixed to claret
steps: Tie in a cream tail.
Dub a claret body.
Tie in a golden badger hackle.
Wind it and finish.

new.name: Craft Fur Deceiver
new.description: A light Deceiver with a grizzly hackle tail, a craft fur body, holographic eyes and a flexible resin head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for bass, stripers and inshore species.
steps: Tie in grizzly hackles as a tail.
Tie craft fur around the shank in bunches.
Comb and trim to a baitfish shape.
Add eyes and coat the head with resin.

new.name: Dark Spinner
new.description: A Bergman wet fly with a purple tail, a wine floss body ribbed with violet, a purple hackle and a dark slate quill wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk.
steps: Tie in the purple tail.
Wind a wine floss body and rib it with violet.
Add a purple hackle.
Tie a slate quill wing and finish.

new.name: Near Nuff Crawfish
new.description: Dave Whitlock's crawfish with burnt mono eyes, painted dumbbell eyes and a simple, buggy body that rides point up.
new.fishing_tips: Crawl and hop it along the bottom.
mats: 50 lb hard Mason, black nail polish
steps: Tie lead eyes near the eye so the hook rides up.
Tie mono eyes and claws at the bend.
Dub a buggy body with legs along the sides.
Pick out the dubbing and finish.

new.name: Deadly Stillwater
new.description: A small stillwater leech on a jig hook with a black marabou and red flash tail, a black Brill body and a chartreuse tungsten bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator or on a slow strip.
mats: Black schlappen marabou with two strands of red Crystal Flash
steps: Slide on the bead.
Tie in a marabou tail with two strands of red flash.
Wrap a Brill body forward.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Embden Fancy
new.description: A Maine feather-wing streamer with a silver body, a white bucktail belly, a peacock underwing, paired dyed grizzly wings and jungle cock.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for brook trout and landlocks.
mats: Pairs of blue, orange and yellow dyed grizzly
steps: Wind a silver body.
Tie in a white belly and mallard throat.
Add a peacock underwing.
Layer the dyed grizzly wings and add jungle cock shoulders.

new.name: F.A.B.
new.description: A Foam Arsed Blob with a black booby foam tail and a Jelly Fritz body and thorax, a UK stillwater lure.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a sinking line for stocked trout.
steps: Tie a short piece of booby foam at the bend as a tail.
Wrap a Jelly Fritz body.
Wrap a lighter Jelly Fritz thorax.
Stroke the fibres back and finish.

new.name: F.R.S. Fancy
new.description: A Rangeley bucktail with a silver body, a white bucktail underbelly, a white hackle throat and a brown over orange bucktail wing.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks and brook trout.
steps: Wind a silver body.
Tie in a white bucktail underbelly.
Add a white hackle throat.
Tie in orange then brown bucktail and finish a banded head.

new.name: Float
new.description: A parachute attractor with a calf tail tail and post, a peacock body with gold rib and brown and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles.
steps: Tie in a calf tail bunch with tips back as the tail and stand the butts up as a post.
Tie in the rib and wrap a peacock body.
Rib the body.
Wind brown and grizzly hackles around the post.

new.name: Gartside Soft Hackle
new.description: Jack Gartside's soft hackle streamer: one or two marabou blood quills wound as a hackle with a mallard or pheasant rump collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it with short strips; it pulses like a jellyfish.
mats: One or two marabou blood quills
steps: Tie in a marabou feather by the tip near the eye.
Wind it forward like a hackle, stroking the fibres back.
Wind a second marabou if you want more bulk.
Wind a mallard or rump collar and add eyes if you like.

new.name: Gartside Sparrow
new.description: Jack Gartside's buggy all-purpose nymph with a marabou tail, a squirrel and rabbit body, a pheasant rump collar and an aftershaft head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it dead-drift or stripped slowly.
mats: Grey squirrel, rabbit and olive Antron dubbing
steps: Tie in a short marabou tail.
Dub a buggy body.
Wind a pheasant rump collar.
Wind an aftershaft feather as a fluffy head.

new.name: Golden Nugget
new.description: A golden stonefly nymph with a gold bead, a crest tail, a wool body, a black wire rib, yellow legs and a turkey wing case.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in summer.
steps: Add the bead and lead and tie in a crest tail.
Dub the abdomen and rib it with black wire.
Tie in the wing case and legs, then dub the thorax.
Pull the wing case over and finish.

new.name: Golden Pheasant
new.description: A Bergman wet fly with a gold tag and rib, an orange floss body, an orange throat and a golden pheasant tippet wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout and panfish.
steps: Tie a gold tag and a black quill tail.
Wind an orange floss body and rib it.
Tie in an orange throat.
Tie a tippet wing and finish.

new.name: Governor
new.description: An old wet fly with a red tag, a peacock herl body, turkey slip wings and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for brook trout.
steps: Tie a short red tag.
Wrap a peacock herl body.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Tie turkey slip wings on top.

new.name: Green Hornet
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver body, a white bucktail underbelly, a crest throat and green hackle wings.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks.
mats: White mono, black and olive green
steps: Wind a silver body.
Tie in a white bucktail underbelly.
Add a crest throat.
Set the green hackle wing and finish a banded head.

new.name: Con Man
new.description: Gunnar Brammer's rabbit streamer with a magnum rabbit wing, a flash blend underbody, a Frankendub head and dragon eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it with jerks and pauses for bass and big trout.
steps: Tie a magnum rabbit strip on top as the wing.
Tie flash blend underneath as the belly.
Spin Frankendub in a loop for the head.
Glue on dragon eyes.

new.name: Hammerhead
new.description: A heavy bass fly with gold bead chain eyes, a glow Mylar Motion and sili leg tail and a two-part Antron body.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it along the bottom.
mats: Glow Mylar Motion and sili legs
steps: Wrap the lead and tie on the bead chain eyes.
Tie in a tail of Mylar Motion and sili legs.
Wrap the rear body.
Build the front body around the eyes and finish.

new.name: Henry's Fork Hopper
new.description: Mike Lawson's hopper with an elk rump body, a yellow elk wing, a speckled hen overwing and an elk bullet head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it along grassy banks in summer.
mats: Natural elk or deer hair, bullet style
steps: Tie elk rump in reverse and fold it back to form an extended body.
Tie in a yellow elk wing.
Add a stiffened hen overwing.
Form a bullet head of elk hair and finish.

new.name: Iron Blue Wingless
new.description: A North Country spider with a crimson thread tag, a light mole dubbing body and a honey dun hen hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in cold weather when iron blues hatch.
steps: Tie in two tail barbs.
Dub a thin mole body, letting the thread show at the tail.
Tie in the hen hackle.
Wind two turns and finish.

new.name: Katydid
new.description: A Bergman wet fly with a silver tip, a chartreuse tail and body and a chartreuse hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in summer.
steps: Tie a silver tip and a chartreuse quill tail.
Wind a fluorescent chartreuse floss body.
Rib it with silver.
Wind a chartreuse hackle and finish.

new.name: Bangtail T&A
new.description: Kelly Galloup's articulated streamer with saddle and marabou tail, marabou wings, a Laser Dub wing and an Ice Dub body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it hard for big trout.
steps: Tie a saddle and marabou tail on the rear hook.
Add a marabou wing and connect the front hook.
Tie a marabou underbody and Ice Dub body on the front hook.
Spin a Laser Dub wing and finish.

new.name: Kings River Caddis
new.description: A low-floating caddis with an olive dubbed body, a mottled turkey wing and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during caddis hatches.
steps: Dub an olive body.
Tie a mottled turkey wing tent-style.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Wind it and finish.

new.name: Larry
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver tag and rib, an orange floss body and a bucktail and hackle wing.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks.
steps: Tie a silver tag and wind an orange floss body.
Rib it with silver.
Tie in a white bucktail underbelly.
Set the hackle wing and build a banded head.

new.name: Lowry
new.description: A vintage wet fly with a yellow tag, a peacock herl body, a long brown hackle and pheasant tail quill wings, tied on a blind snelled hook.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for brook trout.
steps: Tie the snell and a yellow tag.
Wrap a peacock body.
Tie in a long brown hackle.
Tie pheasant tail slip wings.

new.name: M&M Leech
new.description: A small stillwater leech with a marabou and flash tail, an opal mylar body, a red flash rib, an ostrich hackle and a gold bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly on an intermediate line.
mats: Black schlappen marabou with red Crystal Flash
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the tail.
Wrap an opal mylar body.
Rib it with red flash.
Wind a black ostrich collar.

new.name: Magalloway
new.description: A classic Maine wet fly with a gold tip, a yellow tail, a black chenille tag, a brown body, a brown hen hackle and a peacock sword wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for brook trout.
steps: Tie the tip and tail.
Wrap a black chenille tag.
Dub a brown body and add the hackle.
Tie a peacock sword wing.

new.name: Micro Chubby
new.description: A small Chubby with a pearl flash tail, an amber Simi Seal underbody, an orange foam overbody and rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a small hopper or stonefly in a dry-dropper.
steps: Tie in a short flash tail.
Dub a Simi Seal underbody.
Tie the foam down on top.
Add rubber legs at the tie-down point.

new.name: Pumpkin Midge Larva
new.description: A simple midge larva with a pumpkin thread body, a silver wire rib and a dark olive thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep.
steps: Tie in a small silver wire.
Build a slim pumpkin thread body.
Rib it with the wire.
Build a small dark olive thread thorax.

new.name: Moose Mane Midge
new.description: A midge with a body of three moose mane strands, a peacock thorax and a white CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film.
steps: Tie in three strands of moose mane and wrap a banded body.
Tie in a short white CDC wing.
Wrap a peacock herl thorax.
Whip finish.

new.name: Mr. Rapidan Soft Hackle
new.description: Harry Murray's soft hackle nymph with a natural fur rear body, a yellow Antron front, copper rib and speckled hen.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in Virginia-style mountain streams.
mats: Natural fur rear, yellow Antron front
steps: Add lead and tie in the rib.
Dub the rear body.
Dub a yellow front body and rib it.
Wind a speckled hen hackle.

new.name: Orange Fish Hawk
new.description: A simple wet with a gold tag and rib, an orange floss body and a badger hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets.
steps: Tie a gold tag and tie in the rib.
Wind an orange floss body.
Rib it with gold.
Wind a badger hackle and finish.

new.name: Panfish Wiggler
new.description: A small wiggler with bead chain eyes, a squirrel tail and back, a peacock body and palmered grizzly.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly for bluegill.
steps: Tie on bead chain eyes and a squirrel tail.
Tie in the squirrel for the back, a grizzly hackle and peacock herl.
Wrap the peacock body and palmer the hackle.
Pull the squirrel over as a back and tie off behind the eyes.

new.name: Parachute Midge
new.description: A tiny parachute midge with a post, a dark dubbed body and a grizzly hackle one size larger than the hook.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to sipping trout.
steps: Tie in a short post.
Dub a slim dark body.
Tie in a grizzly hackle one size larger than the hook.
Wind it around the post and finish.

new.name: Pheasant Tail Midge
new.description: A midge pupa with a red tag, a pheasant tail abdomen, silver rib, red tinsel thorax, peacock head and white gills.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator.
steps: Leave a short red thread tag and tie in the silver wire.
Wrap a dark pheasant tail abdomen and rib it.
Wrap a short red tinsel thorax.
Wrap a peacock herl head and tie in white thread gills on top.

new.name: PMD Biot Nymph
new.description: A slim PMD nymph with a mallard tail, a goose biot abdomen, a pheasant wing case and a squirrel thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it before PMD hatches.
steps: Tie in a short barred mallard tail.
Wrap a brown goose biot abdomen.
Tie in pheasant tail barbs for the wing case and dub a squirrel thorax.
Pull the wing case over and finish.

new.name: Polar White
new.description: An all-white salmon and steelhead fly with a floss body, a white saddle collar and a reindeer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in low light.
steps: Wind a white floss body, leaving a strand to twist as a rib.
Rib the body with the twisted floss.
Tie in a white reindeer hair wing.
Wind a white saddle collar and finish a black head.

new.name: Red Ash
new.description: A vintage wet with a gold tag and rib, a palmered ginger hackle, a red floss body and mallard tip wings.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for brook trout.
steps: Tie a gold oval tinsel tag and tie in the rib and a small ginger hackle.
Wind a red floss body and palmer the ginger hackle through it.
Rib the body with gold.
Wind a ginger wet hackle and tie mallard flank tips as wings.

new.name: Red Hackle
new.description: An old British wet with a bronze peacock body, a narrow gold rib and a red furnace hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets.
steps: Tie in a narrow gold rib.
Twist bronze peacock herl and wrap a full body.
Rib it with the gold tinsel.
Wind a red furnace hackle and finish with crimson silk.

new.name: Red Ibis
new.description: A bright vintage wet with a gold tag and rib, a red floss body, a red hackle and red wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for brook trout.
steps: Tie a flat gold tag.
Wind a red floss body and rib it with flat gold.
Tie in a red saddle hackle wet style.
Tie a pair of red slips on top as wings.

new.name: Headbanger Sculpin
new.description: Rich Strolis' articulated sculpin with palmered marabou, schlappen, cactus chenille, rubber legs and a craft fur wing.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it near the bottom.
steps: Tie a palmered two-colour marabou tail with holographic flash on the rear hook.
Wind schlappen, then a cactus chenille body with rubber legs.
Join the rear hook to the front hook with wire.
Tie a craft fur wing and build a wide head on the front hook.

new.name: Saltwater Teaser
new.description: A teaser of white and chartreuse bucktail, a Gliss-N-Glint wing and a chartreuse marabou collar on Kevlar thread.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it ahead of a jig or lure.
steps: Tie in white and chartreuse bucktail with red Kevlar thread.
Tie in a Gliss-N-Glint wing on top.
Wind a chartreuse marabou collar.
Build a red head and coat it.

new.name: Shenk's Cress Bug
new.description: Ed Shenk's cress bug of mixed furs in a dubbing loop trimmed flat top and bottom.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in spring creeks.
mats: Muskrat, mink and otter fur without guard hair, in a loop and trimmed
steps: Spin a mix of muskrat, mink and otter fur in a dubbing loop.
Wrap it forward along the shank.
Trim the body flat on top and bottom.
Trim the sides oval and finish.

new.name: Simple Red Worm
new.description: A weighted worm of red catgut Biothread.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it after rain.
steps: Wrap a few turns of 0.020 wire for weight.
Tie in a length of red Biothread at the bend.
Wrap it forward in tight turns to form a segmented worm.
Tie off and whip finish.

new.name: Thor
new.description: Jim Pray's steelhead fly with an orange tail, a red chenille body, a brown hen hackle and a white bucktail wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for winter steelhead.
steps: Tie in an orange hen tail.
Wrap a red chenille body.
Wind a brown hen hackle.
Tie a white bucktail wing and finish.

new.name: Tups Indispensable
new.description: R.S. Austin's classic with a dun tail, a yellow silk body, a pink thorax and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during olive hatches.
steps: Tie in a blue dun tail.
Wrap a slim yellow silk body.
Dub a small pink thorax.
Wind a blue dun hackle and finish.

new.name: Victory
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver tag, red tail, red floss body and silver rib.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks.
steps: Tie a silver tag and a red hackle tail.
Wind a red floss body.
Rib it with silver mylar.
Set the hackle wing and build a banded head.

new.name: West Branch Caddis
new.description: A caddis with a shaggy rabbit body, a wood duck or mallard flank wing, partridge legs and a rabbit head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film.
steps: Dub a shaggy rabbit body.
Tie a wood duck or mallard wing flat over the back.
Tie in partridge legs on each side.
Dub a small rabbit head.

new.name: White Ghost
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver tag, an orange floss body, a silver rib and a white peacock underbelly.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks.
steps: Tie a silver tag.
Wind an orange floss body.
Rib it with silver.
Add a peacock underbelly and white hackle wing and finish.

new.name: Widow
